title: Is Samsung Gearing Up to Challenge Qualcomm Inc. and MediaTek?
text: Interestingly enough, while Samsung has sold applications processors to other handset makers such as Lenovo , the company is not generally regarded as a large player in the merchant mobile silicon market; Qualcomm and MediaTek are the big dogs here.
